subtitle: 식당 주문 · 문장별 음성 재생
desc: 식당에서 자리 잡고 음식 주문할 때

tips.en: Could I have a few more minutes?
How would you like that cooked?
Could we have the check later?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Hi. A table for two, please.

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Of course. Right this way. Here are your menus.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Thank you. Could I have a few more minutes?

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Sure. Just let me know when you're ready.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: We're ready. I'd like the grilled salmon, please.

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Great choice. How would you like that cooked?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Medium, please. And could I get the dressing on the side?
turns.ko: 미디엄으로 주세요. 그리고 드레싱은 별도로 주세요.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Just water for now. Could we have the check later?
turns.ko: 지금은 물로 해 주세요. 계산서는 나중에 주시겠어요?

turns.speaker: Server
turns.en: Of course. I'll bring it whenever you're ready.
